fact: On 30 November 2021 the INIC director said a first draft of the Quadro Nacional de Interoperabilidade, a set of rules and standards for how information is exchanged across public administration, was under discussion with a final version expected by year end or early the next year.
title: INIC promove whorkshop sobre a padronização e digitalização da Administração Pública
publisher: Rádio Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
